criteria.title: SDOF and cantilever frequencies

modal-protocol: SetMassSource with a dimensioned mass gives the SDOF closed form

criteria.observation: Tip mass on a massless cantilever matches √(3EI/mL³) per plane and √(EA/mL) to 1e-9 with both mass matrices; cantilever bending (both planes, modes 1–3) and torsion converge from above to within 1e-4/1e-3 at 16 elements; simply supported (nπ)² and quarter-wave axial modes (second-order convergence) match.

criteria.title: Documented element mass matrices and generalised eigen solve
criteria.observation: Consistent and lumped matrices reproduce the exact kinetic energy of rigid motions in both bending planes; K φ = ω² M φ by the stability-v1 subspace iteration with a Sturm count matches a spring–mass chain to 1e-10 and never reports massless directions.

criteria.title: Mass scaling
criteria.observation: Scaling every mass by 4 halves every frequency to 1e-12 and leaves every participation ratio unchanged, for both mass matrices.

criteria.title: Mode orthogonality
criteria.observation: ΦᵀMΦ = I and ΦᵀKΦ = Ω² to 1e-8 with per-mode residuals ≤ 1e-8 and a Sturm count equal to the modes below the shift; every result records both orthogonality measures.

criteria.title: Independent oracle generated by the recorded script
criteria.observation: tools/oracles/modal_oracle.py sha256 392e041c48afc9925dc8e1a79fa0bb2e85dba787b9e6dddd2b075942775d9eec; recorded 392e041c48afc9925dc8e1a79fa0bb2e85dba787b9e6dddd2b075942775d9eec; OpenSees 3.4.0 cross-check; internal checks passed.

limitations: dynamics-v1 is undamped free vibration of the elastic Euler–Bernoulli model about its unstressed geometry with declared mass, translational participation only, no rotary inertia, no member end releases and no rigid-body modes. Frequencies are not a floor-vibration or code serviceability verdict; response spectra, time history and harmonic response are M15. Commercial-solver parity remains UNKNOWN.
